additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0415641 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Maybe
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Maybe
Performance monitoring by RC
Please refer to the ticket notes in the ISP for more information shared by the customer. The CMS was installed later on-site, and it appears that the installation was done incorrectly. The clamps of the CMS should be connected to the middle of the DC cable to ensure the cable hangs properly and not touches the ground. Currently, the clamps are connected near the cable gland of the DC cable, causing the cables to touch the ground. If the clamps are defective or the adhesive is not strong enough, we recommend ordering a spare part.
MLFB: 8EM5905-0AA00-7AA1 (Cable management system cable clamps, set of two)
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
